title: 第9章 肉疼的秦管事第10章 淬体丹
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 两人就这样平静的擦肩而过，周围的环境静的可怕，其中似乎酝酿着接下来的一波攻势。
不管其他，此刻的孙冰缓缓的来到了账房，准备领取昨夜执法长老承诺的奖励，他可不会故作清高，该是自己的那就一定跑不掉。
淬体丹顾名思义，就是淬炼身体的丹药，尤其适合淬体境界的修士，服用淬体丹之后再锻炼，原先需要一年时间才能突破的境界，现在完全能够缩短一半。
在市面上也是价值连城，需要整整一百两银子才能够买到一瓶。也只有孙家这种家大业大的人，才能够给弟子每月搭配一瓶。
这丹药对于孙冰来说，更是重要，要知道从小到大他都没有服用过淬体丹，现在若是服用的话，效果一定会更加的显着，那么淬体四层境界，也就指日可待了。
因为不是月俸发放的日子，所以账房中人迹罕至，隔得很远，孙冰就看见了秦管事，只见对方正安逸的躺在一张躺椅上，椅子全部都是由雷击木制作，其中因为蕴含了闪电的气息，长年累月的坐在这样的椅子上，虽然对修炼并无帮助，但却相当的舒服。
而且椅子旁还有着一张小木桌，桌子上摆放着一盘野果与一杯茶水，秦管事时不时就拿起一颗野果品尝，亦或者抿一口茶水，样子倒显得相当悠闲。
这让孙冰的双眼一缩，要知道市面上采用雷击木制作的椅子最少也需要五百两银子，面前这躺椅的价值一定更高，而且那野果也是荒野之中才能生长，单单一颗就需要一两银子，平民根本就享用不起，至于茶水他倒是看不出来。
可即便是这样，也足以体现出了秦管事的土豪了，桌上的一盘野果就相当于孙冰一个月的月俸了，难怪被养的白白胖胖，宛若一个皮球似得。
“秦管事的生活当真是悠闲啊。”突然间，一道话语打断了秦管事平静而又悠闲的生活，这让他相当的恼怒，当下立刻坐起了身子，朝着四周望去。
一眼就看到了面前的孙冰，嘴角阴冷一笑：“我道是谁呢？原来是你这个废物，今天可不是发放月俸的日子，你还是赶快滚吧。”
说完又继续躺到了椅子上，安安静静的享受着自己悠闲的时光，秦管事的工作其实相当轻松，唯一需要做的就是每个月发放月俸，其余时间则是家族子弟前来领取奖励，只不过他并不认为孙冰有那个资格。
只不过现在的孙冰再也不是以前的那个人，曾经的他无法修炼，所以需要忍受无边的屈辱，但他此刻已经成为了一个修士了，更何况身上还有执法长老的令牌。
当下一声冷哼：“秦管事，我需要领取三瓶淬体丹，还请取出来给我。”声音严厉，没有一丝一毫的客气。
这让秦管事相当怒火，做他这项工作，最主要的就是消息灵通，知道什么人能得罪，什么人不能得罪，心中都有一杆称，大人物多给点好处，至于无人出头的小人物他根本就不在乎对方的想法。
所以他才凭借孙家外戚的身份，安安稳稳的坐上了这一个位置，最主要的就是他懂得做人，别说是长老的弟子前来，就算孙龙的下人过来他照样客客气气的。
但很显然，在秦管事的心中，孙冰完全不属于不能得罪的那一伙人中，猛然间听到了这一句话，口中甚至含怒道：“就你这个废物还想要淬体丹，等下辈子吧，看在我今天心情不错的份上，赶快滚吧。”
只不过孙冰并没有离开，依旧淡淡的说：“长老奖励我三瓶淬体丹，还希望秦管事莫要自误。”
“莫要自误？你以为你是谁？还能是一方长老么？”秦管事再也无法忍受了，当下直接站起了身子，口中喊到：“给你脸不要脸，竟然还赖在这里不走，那么就别别我手下无情了。”
当即手中力道十足的孙冰挥拳而去，秦管事虽然天资不足，但奈何是账房的管事，硬生生的依靠资源的堆积，都让他修炼到了淬体九层，只不过再也没有办法突破至炼气期罢了。
但这个境界对于一众弟子来说，还是相当高深了，此刻，秦管事拳法凛冽，带起了阵阵拳风，甚至将孙冰那本来就飘逸的长发向后吹去，若还不停止的话，接下来孙冰必定身受重伤。
但也就是在此时，只见孙冰淡淡的从怀中取出一枚令牌，这让秦管事小小的双眼中露出惊恐的神色，口中惊呼：“你怎么可能有执法长老的令牌。”
然后已经将已经挥出去的拳头硬生生止住。
content_en:
The two of them passed by each other calmly. The surrounding environment was terrifyingly quiet, and the next wave of offensive seemed to be brewing in it.
Regardless of anything else, Sun Bing slowly came to the accounting room at this moment, preparing to receive the reward promised by the law enforcement elder last night. He would not pretend to be aloof. If it was his, he would not be able to escape.
As the name suggests, the Body Tempering Pill is a pill that tempers the body. It is especially suitable for monks in the Body Tempering realm. After taking the Body Tempering Pill and then exercising, the realm that originally took a year to break through can now be shortened by half.
It is also extremely valuable in the market, requiring a full one hundred taels of silver to buy a bottle. Only people like the Sun family, who have a big family and a big business, can give their disciples a bottle every month.
This pill is even more important to Sun Bing. You must know that he has never taken the Body Tempering Pill since he was a child. If he takes it now, the effect will be more significant, and the fourth level of Body Tempering will be just around the corner.
Because it was not the day when the monthly salary was distributed, there were few people in the accounting room. From a distance, Sun Bing saw Manager Qin, who was lying comfortably on a recliner. The chairs were all made of lightning strike wood, which contained the breath of lightning. Sitting on such a chair for many years was not helpful for cultivation, but it was quite comfortable.
There is also a small wooden table next to the chair. There is a plate of wild fruits and a cup of tea on the table. From time to time, Manager Qin will pick up a wild fruit to taste, or take a sip of tea, looking quite leisurely.
This made Sun Bing's eyes shrink. You must know that a chair made of lightning wood on the market costs at least five hundred taels of silver. The value of the recliner in front of him must be higher, and the wild fruit can only grow in the wilderness. Just one fruit costs one tael of silver. Common people cannot afford it at all. As for tea, he can't tell.
But even this is enough to show the richness of Manager Qin. A plate of wild fruits on the table is equivalent to one month's salary of Sun Bing. No wonder he is as fat and white as a rubber ball.
"Steward Qin's life is really leisurely." Suddenly, a word interrupted Steward Qin's peaceful and leisurely life, which made him quite angry. He immediately sat up and looked around.
He caught sight of Sun Bing in front of him and smiled coldly: "Who is it? It turns out to be you, a loser. Today is not a day for monthly salary distribution. You'd better get out of here."
After saying that, he continued to lie down on the chair and quietly enjoyed his leisure time. Manager Qin's job was actually quite easy. The only thing he had to do was to pay out the monthly salary. The rest of the time, the family members came to receive the rewards, but he didn't think Sun Bing had the qualifications.
It's just that Sun Bing is no longer the same person as before. He used to be unable to practice, so he had to endure endless humiliation, but now he has become a monk, not to mention that he still has the token of the law enforcement elder.
Then there was a cold snort: "Manager Qin, I need to receive three bottles of body tempering pills. Please take them out and give them to me." The voice was stern, without any courtesy.
This made Manager Qin very angry. The most important thing for him in his job was to be well-informed and know who could be offended and who could not be offended. He had an idea in his mind. Big people would give more benefits. As for the little people who had no one to stand out, he didn't care at all what the other party thought.
That's why he was able to sit in this position safely by virtue of his status as a relative of the Sun family. The most important thing is that he knows how to behave. Even if Sun Long's servants come, let alone the disciples of the elders, he will still be polite.
But it was obvious that in the mind of Manager Qin, Sun Bing did not belong to the group of people who could not be offended. He suddenly heard this sentence and even said angrily: "You are a loser who still wants the Body Tempering Pill. You can wait for the next life. For the sake of my good mood today, get out of here."
However, Sun Bing did not leave, and still said calmly: "The elder rewarded me with three bottles of body tempering pills, and I also hope that Manager Qin will not make mistakes."
"Don't mistake yourself? Who do you think you are? Can you be an elder?" Manager Qin couldn't bear it anymore. He stood up and shouted: "You are so shameless that you are still here and won't leave, so don't be ruthless to me."
Immediately, Sun Bing, who was very powerful in his hand, punched away. Although Manager Qin was not talented enough, he was still a steward in the accounting room. He relied on the accumulation of resources to cultivate to the ninth level of body tempering, but he could no longer break through to the Qi refining stage.
But this realm is still quite advanced for a group of disciples. At this moment, Qin Guanshi's boxing skills were so fierce that he brought up bursts of fist wind, and even blew Sun Bing's already flowing long hair back. If it didn't stop, Sun Bing would definitely be seriously injured next.
But at this moment, Sun Bing was seen taking out a token from his arms, which made Manager Qin look frightened in his small eyes, and exclaimed: "How can you have the token of the law enforcement elder."
Then he stopped the fist that had been thrown out.
title_en: Chapter 9: The Painful Manager Qin Chapter 10: Body Tempering Pill
